# Agentic Builders

> Early-stage venture fund investing from idea to pre-seed in agent-native applications: products AI agents use and tools for building agent products. First checks of $30k–$80k on a standard post-money SAFE, founder cohorts, and help reaching the next round. Based in Delaware, US. Founded 2025.

## Key facts

- Stage: idea to pre-seed
- First check: $30,000–$80,000, standard post-money SAFE, no follow-on checks
- Thesis: (a) products agents can find and use to research, work with data, communicate, buy, sell, create content and run business tasks; (b) tools to build, test, secure, launch, track and sell agent products
- Teams: AI-native founders who have built a startup before, sell into the US, have someone on the team who sells, can be in the US, and share numbers monthly
- Format: cohorts with a shared start, weekly rhythm, shared go-to-market materials, guild sessions, tool credits, and a demo day with friendly funds
- The founder builds the product; the fund funds the start and gets the team to the next investors
- Apply: https://accidental-podium-c67.notion.site/a5032a0b4b1982f89291014f2df73ba9 (reviewed weekly)
- Contact: hey@agenticbuilders.ai
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/agentic-builders-ai/
